role: Workout data model (Sport is in Sport.swift): Split/Lap/LiveMarker/WorkoutSample/HRRSample value types, WorkoutMetadata (all workout-specific fields stored on HRVSession.workoutMetadata, with explicit additive Codable and the cross-source training-load resolver), WorkoutWeatherSnapshot, PartialDataReason, and [HRRSample] best-reading helpers.
types: Lap: struct (Codable) — user/interval segment (not produced by the recorder; kept for decode)
LiveMarker: struct (Codable) + Kind enum — timeline markers (never placed; kept for decode)
WorkoutSample: struct (Codable) — per-second tick row with custom tolerant decode
HRRSample: struct (Codable) + Provenance enum — post-stop HR recovery
WorkoutPauseSpan: struct (Codable, Equatable, Sendable) — one recorded pause (active second it began at, wall-clock length)
WorkoutMetadata: struct (Codable, Equatable) — workout extras, load resolver, explicit Codable
WorkoutMetadata.TrainingLoadSource: enum — power/hr/mets/banister/routeHistory with display label
WorkoutWeatherSnapshot: struct (Codable, Sendable) + extension init from HealthKit metadata
state: mem:WorkoutMetadata.currentSchemaVersion = 1 (written as schemaVersion, never read back)
archive: WorkoutMetadata is persisted inside HRVSession (CodingKeys at Emuqu/Sources/Models/WorkoutMetadata.swift:722-738)
toplevel: Split, Lap, LiveMarker, HRRSample, WorkoutWeatherSnapshot, PartialDataReason and TrainingLoadSource use synthesized conformances. WorkoutSample.CodingKeys lists all 9 fields. WorkoutMetadata.CodingKeys (722-738) covers every stored property except unrecognizedSportRawValue (written back under the sport key) plus schemaVersion; the split encoder writes every key (hrTSS is written by encodePowerMetrics, not encodeLoadMetrics as its doc comment groups it). WorkoutMetadata.unrecognizedSportRawValue (private(set), nil by default) holds a sport string this build does not know. WorkoutPauseSpan uses synthesized Codable; WorkoutMetadata.pauseSpans is coded under key pauseSpans (tolerant decode).

flags.text: LiveMarker is never constructed and WorkoutMetadata.liveMarkers is never assigned or read in production (only round-tripped by Codable and copied by carryForward); Lap is constructed only by CloudKitSyncSupport's HR-stripping copy and tests, so laps is never produced. The doc comments describing interval/hill/strap/auto-pause markers and user/interval laps describe nothing the app records.

Unknown values in the nested enums (LiveMarker.Kind, HRRSample.Provenance, PartialDataReason) from a newer build no longer fail the decode, but the whole liveMarkers/hrrSamples array or partialDataReason decodes as nil (logged), and a re-save on this build drops them from the stored copy; only the sport string is preserved for write-back.

units.does: Returns a copy of the sample with only alpha1 replaced (used by WorkoutAlpha1Reanalyzer.swift:139-140).

Returns a copy with only heartRate replaced. Used by the finalize-time Apple Watch HR backfill (WorkoutRecorder+Lifecycle.swift:558) and by CloudKitSyncSupport.swift:663/761 to strip or restore Apple-Health HR rows.
Memberwise init; every field except offsetSec defaults to nil.
Decodes a sample: offsetSec required (throws if missing), all other fields decodeIfPresent so rows written before powerWatts existed still load.
units.entry: Decodable requirement, invoked by JSONDecoder when WorkoutMetadata.samples is decoded from the archive/CloudKit.

units.does: Maps a PauseTimeline's spans to WorkoutPauseSpan values for WorkoutMetadata.pauseSpans; nil when there were no pauses.

Pause-excluded second (the clock of WorkoutSample.offsetSec) for a moment wallClockSeconds after the start: walks pauseSpans in order, subtracting each pause that ended before the moment; a moment inside a pause maps to that pause's atElapsed; truncates to Int. Inverse of PauseTimeline.wallClock(forOffset:). Without pauseSpans returns Int(wallClockSeconds).

branches.cond: for each pause span in atElapsed order
moment not after the pause start

units.does: Inverse of activeOffset(forWallClockSeconds:): the wall-clock seconds after the start of active (pause-excluded) second activeOffset — activeOffset plus the lengths of every pause span whose atElapsed is before it. The second a pause began at maps to the start of that pause. Without pause spans the clocks agree.
Display label for a load source: 'LOAD' for TSS-scale sources (power, hr, mets), 'TRIMP' for banister/routeHistory, localized.
METs-based load (TSS scale): per-sample integration, else single-bucket estimate, else nil.

branches.effect: falls back to bucketMETLoad(); nil when both are nil

units.does: Integrates mets × per-sample duration (capped 1..30 s) over samples sorted by offset into MET-hours and converts with loadFromMETHours; nil when fewer than 30 samples, fewer than a quarter carry mets>0, or MET-hours <= 0.01.

branches.effect: row skipped (continue), not counted as valid
returns nil (stream too sparse); otherwise returns loadFromMETHours

units.does: Seconds represented by sample i: gap to the next sample clamped to [1, 30]; the last sample counts as 1 s.

Single-bucket METs load: average km/h from distance and moving time (last sample offset), METs from METLookup.mets at that speed, × moving hours, normalized by loadFromMETHours. Reads no settings; nil for a workout with no samples.

branches.cond: distance missing or <= 50 m, no valid average km/h, METs nil/<=0, or moving duration nil/< 60 s
branches.effect: returns nil; otherwise returns the bucket load

units.does: Mean km/h = distance / moving time; nil when either is missing/zero or the result is outside (0.5, 60) km/h.

branches.effect: nil (treated as GPS noise / no motion); else kmh

units.does: Moving seconds = highest sample offsetSec; nil without samples.
Converts MET-hours to TSS-scale load: metHours / 12 × 100; nil when metHours <= 0.01 or load <= 0.5.

Main-actor power TSS: storedPowerTSS if present, else TrainingLoadPrecedence.readTimePowerTSS from stored NP, moving time and the current FTP anchors (user FTP or cached auto-estimate) from settingsManager.settings.

branches.effect: returns it; otherwise derives read-time TSS (nil without NP/FTP/>60 s samples)

units.does: Power TSS from stored fields: when intensityFactor > 0 and moving time > 60 s, IF² × moving hours × 100 (re-derived over moving time); else stored powerTSS if > 0; else nil.

branches.cond: intensityFactor > 0 and samples give > 60 s moving time
branches.effect: returns the moving-time recomputation (overrides the stored powerTSS)

units.does: True when extrapolatedTRIMP > 0 with confidence > 0.4 (built from at least one prior run) and luciaTRIMP (nil treated as 0) < 0.5 × that estimate.

branches.cond: estimate missing/<=0, confidence missing, or confidence <= 0.4

branches.effect: treated as 0, so the estimate replaces the HR load

units.does: Main-actor preferred training load with source: returns TrainingLoadPrecedence.stored(self) with its default FTP anchors from the settings snapshot — storedPowerTSS or read-time power TSS → route estimate when routeEstimateReplacesHRLoad → hrTSS → computedMETLoad → luciaTRIMP → extrapolatedTRIMP → nil, the same figure ATL/CTL count. Used by history calendar, workout rows, share card and load tiles.
Lightweight memberwise init for sport, geometry, splits/laps/markers, samples, HRR and HR-load fields; all other properties start nil.

Decodes WorkoutMetadata: sport via decodedSport (an unknown sport reads as .run, its string kept in unrecognizedSportRawValue; a missing sport throws), liveMarkers / pauseSpans / hrrSamples / partialDataReason through the tolerant optionalValue (unreadable, e.g. an enum case from a newer build → nil and logged), decodeIfPresent for every other field (missing keys → nil). schemaVersion is not read. Throws only on a missing sport or a malformed value in the remaining fields.
units.entry: Decodable requirement, invoked when an HRVSession is decoded from the archive, CloudKit or Watch payloads.

units.does: Decodes the sport key as a String (throws when absent or not a string); returns the matching Sport, or logs a warning and returns .run when the string is not a Sport this build knows.

branches.cond: string is not a known Sport rawValue

units.does: Returns the stored sport string when it is not a known Sport rawValue; nil when it is known or unreadable.
Encodes all fields via four grouped helpers.
units.entry: Encodable requirement, invoked when an HRVSession is encoded for archive/CloudKit/export.

units.does: Writes schemaVersion (1), sport (unrecognizedSportRawValue when set, else sport.rawValue), gpsPolyline, distance, elevation gain/loss, splits, laps, liveMarkers, pauseSpans, samples, healthKitHROffsets (optionals only when present).
Writes hrrSamples, decouplingPercent, efficiencyFactor, luciaTRIMP when present.
Writes hrTSS, power fields (avg, NP, peak, powerTSS, IF, VI, FTP) and strokeCount/averageSplitSecPer500m when present.
Writes dragFactor, workoutFeeling(+Note), analysisSnapshot, partialDataReason, recoveredAt, extrapolation fields, recognizedRouteName and weatherSnapshot when present.

Failable init from a HealthKit workout's metadata: requires both HKMetadataKeyWeatherTemperature (°C-compatible) and HKMetadataKeyWeatherHumidity (percent-compatible) quantities; builds a snapshot with humidity × 100, no apparent temp/wind/conditions, backfilled=false. Used by HealthWorkoutImporter+Queries.swift:217 and HealthKitManager+Heat.swift:55.

branches.cond: temperature or humidity missing, not an HKQuantity, or unit-incompatible
branches.effect: returns nil; else builds the snapshot

units.does: Localized badge text for why a workout is partial.
Best HRR reading within 60±10 s by provenance preference (strap > watch > HealthKit).
Best HRR reading within 120±15 s by provenance preference.

Filters samples within `tolerance` of `offset` and returns the first one of the highest-priority provenance present (strap, then watchSamples, then healthKitComputed); within one provenance it takes array order, not the closest offset; nil if none.
